purpose: Hot state for recurring XerahS hourly review selection. Keep this file small and machine-readable; archive raw detail separately.
selection_rules: Read this JSON first, then the short current tracker only if human context is needed.
Prefer the stalest high-priority area that is not blocked by a larger prerequisite.
After a run, update the matching area, prepend one compact last_runs item, and archive detailed evidence by log path only.
Do not paste full build/test output into hot state or the current tracker.
next_candidates: Media subsystem (follow-up: thumbnailer oversized-output dimension overflow guards)
Assistant local memory/privacy/history (follow-up: OCR index pruning/retention)

areas.last_outcome: Re-review of DXGI rotated/scaled display bounds and GDI/DXGI cursor parity: DxgiRotationHelper CreateSourceBox/ApplyRotationToTransform math reviewed (correct); BitmapRotationHelper RotateClockwise math reviewed (correct); GDI ShowCursor path uses system cursor hide/restore with CursorData.IsVisible guard; DXGI path uses DxgiCursorCompositionHelper with PhysicalRectangle containment check; both paths handle cursor visibility options correctly. No fixable bugs found in this pass.
areas.follow_up: Continue capture pipeline review around DXGI multi-monitor rotation/scaling edge cases, rotated display bounds, and cursor/selection parity.

areas.last_outcome: Fixed SaveToPathAsync to distinguish image save failures from sidecar save failures. Image encode/IO errors are now caught and reported, leaving IsDirty=true so the user can retry. Sidecar save errors are also caught and reported, but IsDirty is cleared since the primary image was saved successfully. Previously all errors were silently swallowed by the caller and IsDirty was never set on failure.

Added 4 regression tests; bumped version 0.23.34 -> 0.23.35.
